en: Color postcard showing a picturesque pavilion-like building with red tile roofs beside a small pond, reflected in the water and surrounded by dense coniferous forest. The reverse has Romanian handwriting and address, a blue 40 Bani "Posta Română" stamp (industrial cranes), and printed caption crediting the photo and publisher. Caption identifies the view as 'Sinaia. Foișorul.'
